project.name: Castellan Broker :: Raft
project.description: A from-scratch Raft consensus implementation (Ongaro & Ousterhout, "In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm"): leader election, log replication, safety, membership- agnostic transport, and a deterministic single-threaded event-loop core that is unit-testable without any real network or clock. No external consensus library.
